newsitem.title: USA: Piper unit to acquire some ReliaStar assets.
newsitem.headline: Piper unit to acquire some ReliaStar assets.

text.p: Piper Capital Management Inc, an investment management subsidiary of Piper Jaffray Companies Inc, said it agreed to purchase certain client assets of Washington Square Advisers, a unit of ReliaStar Financial Corp.

Washington Square Advisers has $2.7 billion in assets under management. After the transaction closes later this year, Piper Capital will have about $12 billion in assets under management, assuming that the clients of Washington Square Advisers included in the transaction consent to the transfer.
The companies did not disclose the terms of the transaction, but indicated that the deal will not have a material impact on either company's 1997 financial condition.
As part of the acquisition, two Washington Square Advisers portfolio managers, Douglas Hedberg and Gregory Hanson, will join Piper Capital and continue day-to-day management of their clients' assets.

Founded in 1981, Washington Square Advisers specializes in taxable fixed-income portfolio management for institutions such as insurance companies, foundations, endowments and other institutional funds.

ReliaStar is a Minneapolis-based holding company which provides individuals and institutions with life insurance and annuities, employee benefits, reinsurance, retirement plans, mutual funds, and residential mortgages.

"ReliaStar's focus on individual and reinsurance customers would, over time, constrain its ability to provide the necessary support for WSA's continuing growth," said Kenneth U. Kuk, senior vice president, ReliaStar Asset Division, in a joint news release.

Piper Jaffray Companies is a full-service financial services companies. "This acquisition complements our historic strength in fixed income management and supports our objective of growing Piper Capital's assets under management," said Piper Capital President William Ellis, in a news release.
